create.name: Daishinji, Comunidad Soto Zen de Colombia
create.bio:
Daishinji, the Temple of Magnanimous Mind, is the Bogotá home of the Comunidad Soto Zen de Colombia, a non-profit religious body teaching Zen in the line of Dogen. Its abbot is the Venerable Denshō Quintero, a Colombian monk who began Zen practice in 1984, set up a practice centre in Bogotá in 1989, took formal ordination at Antaiji in Japan in 2001 and received Dharma transmission in 2009 from Shohaku Okumura Roshi of Sanshinji in Bloomington, Indiana. Since 2013 he has served as a missionary teacher of the Japanese Soto school for South America, and he was installed as abbot of the temple in 2023.

Practice in Bogotá centres on zazen early each weekday morning and on Saturday, with Tuesday and Thursday evening sittings for those who have already had an introductory talk; the community also has a practice place in Armenia and links with groups elsewhere in Colombia and in Caracas. Sesshin, precepts ceremonies and teishō with question-and-answer sessions round out the year. Teaching is in Spanish, and a long run of the abbot's talks on zazen, the Heart Sutra, buddha nature and daily practice is free on the community's YouTube channel; he has also written and translated several Spanish-language books on Zen.

courses.title: Zazen at Templo Daishin, Bogotá
courses.description: In-person sitting at the Bogotá temple before dawn from Monday to Friday and on Saturday mornings, plus Tuesday and Thursday evenings. Newcomers attend an introductory talk on the practice before joining. Taught in Spanish.

free_resources.title: La Comunidad en vídeo
free_resources.description: The community's index of recorded talks, lectures and ceremonies led by Denshō Quintero, in Spanish, covering zazen, the Heart Sutra, the bodhisattva ideal and practice in everyday life. All free to watch.
